Dialogs.Dialog: Hello？ What are you staring down there？
Do you feel motivated or something？
Why do you keep staring there？
I wonder if you only have one thing on your mind.
Hehe, this is a little embarrassing, you know？
Hmm... Does this suit your tastes？
Hehe. I'm fine. I don't feel lonely.
You don't want to leave？ Hehe, we'll meet again.
Maybe we can do this later, okay？
What？ You want to be spoiled？
What？ You're acting like a kid.
Hehe, you wanna be a spoiled child？
Hehe, what do you want to do？
Can we stay like this a little longer？
Sorry. Can we stay like this...？
I think this is good. Yeah.
Ah, that might be nice, too...
This is a little bit embarrassing...
Um, what is it all of a sudden？
Hehe, I'm in a good mood.
Ah, no. Don't look at me.
Hey, I'm not going to spoil you.
You wanna act more like lovers？
You want to come closer to me, huh？
Hmm, you want to do this...
It's quite big... I mean your hand...
Okay, okay. You don't have to grab my hand that tightly.
Fine, in return, you'll have to grab my hand tightly.
You can keep holding my hand forever.
Is there something sticking on my face？
Hehe... What do you intend to do？
Hehehe. Do you like me that much？
Not yet... This is getting awkward.
Don't be nervous, okay？ Just relax.
I'm so happy when you take charge like this...
You can come closer to me...
Hehe, are you okay？ Can you do it？
I'm not going to refuse, so don't worry.
You can come closer to me. I don't mind.
I don't mind if you want to touch me...
I want you to touch me more...
A little bit more might be good, right？
Hehe, this is still not enough.
Hehe, now I've become like this.
Stay by my side forever, okay？
Don't look at me like that...
It's embarrassing... Don't look at me.
Phew... Somehow, I feel relieved now...
Some more... would be nice, right？
Let us be like this forever.
This is still quite awkward. Maybe we should consider the mood.
Not now. Maybe we can do this later.
No！ Hehe. I was teasing you.
You want to do this again？
You should be gentle to a girl, you know？
Can I stay by your side？
I can feel your body temperature...
I'll get closer to you just a little bit, okay？
Please... Once more. That's okay, right？
I like this more and more...
Hey, one more time... I beg you.
Do it one more time. Okay？
Hey, this is not enough, right？
More... I want to feel you more...
Come closer... Hey, it's okay, right？
I feel as if my heart is going to burst out...
Are you going to kiss me？
I don't mind if you do it.
Are you trying to hold it？
We are thinking about the same thing, aren't we？
You know what to do, right？
I don't think this is good...
I'm not in the mood for this...
Hey... I was really in the mood...
I wanted to get closer to you, but...
Jeez, you don't know anything, do you？ Sensei will teach you.
My, my... Can't you listen to Sensei？ Just be quiet and do as I taught you... okay？
Goodness, you're a hopeless kid. You can't do anything unless Sensei helps you.
Sensei is going to punish kids who don't listen. Prepare yourself.
How's that？ Observe closely and learn from it.
Master... I will serve you forever.
How is my cooking？ I'd be happy if you ate a lot.
Master, you're kind of like a child. Hehe.
I want to go on a diet... but I end up getting seconds.
Delicious food makes me so happy...
It'd be even more delicious if we ate together...
I want to go see him after class is over.
I'm so hungry, I can't concentrate...
Why am I so sleepy？ It feels like I'm in a dream.
I want to tell you I love you a lot more...
I don't want to let go of you anymore...
What, do you want to take the lead？
Do that, and I'll fall asleep？
It's not just ticklish, you know.
What are you trying to see？
When it's you, I get so sensitive.
Hey, what are you thinking about？
Don't blame me if you never want to let go？
Yeah, you want to, don't you？
I was actually waiting for this.
You shouldn't make a girl say it, you know？
Come here, let me spoil you.
Alright, I'm gonna snuggle up to you？
I'll just put all the cups in the fridge...
If I go back to sleep, I won't be able to... wake up...
Mmm... I don't want to move...
I feel like... he was in my dream, too...
Good morning... Huh？ Oh right, he's not here...
He could have given me a wake-up call...
What should I have for breakfast...
I wish I could wake up to his voice...
Naughty boys get punished, you know...？
What was I supposed to do today again...
Maybe a shower will wake me up...
I won't wake up without a good morning kiss...
Why is my bed so incredibly comfy...
